signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch-style home frontage, partially obscured by trees in the foreground but the house, garage, lawn and driveway are visible.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed rounded shrubs and mulched tree beds are neat, but there is no crew, equipment or other clear evidence of professional service.

signals.notes: Well-maintained ranch home with an attached garage and a newly sealed-looking asphalt driveway; two lawn chairs sit near the front walk and a neighboring house with an A/C unit is on the right.
